title: Reported attacks, 1993-2020
description: 7,511 IMB-reported pirate attacks, geocoded, from the Crime at Sea dataset. Aggregates and a 2-degree binned grid derived from the raw CSV, which is not committed. Series ends in 2020; for 2023 onward use threat-stats.json and attack-log.json.

distance_from_shore_km.note: Straight-line distance from the incident position to the nearest shore, in kilometres, as computed by the source.

grid.note: Attack positions binned into 2-degree cells. Coordinates are cell centres, not incident positions.
